title: A step forward for public procurement: OFE identifies opportunities in the newly published Public Procurement Act proposal
content: OpenForum Europe (OFE) welcomes the publication of the Public Procurement Act legislative proposal from the European Commission. This proposal marks a positive move towards a more sovereign and independent Europe, introducing for the first time a strong horizontal legal basis for public buyers to prioritise European producers, new procedures for procurement and specific open source requirements for the soon to be developed Commission eProcurement service.
